author: piztanza
description: SEO refinements (F-010): pipe title separator per user ('Mobeeli | Every part, verified to fit.' / ID 'Mobeeli | Setiap suku cadang, dipastikan cocok.'; join 'Join Waitlist | Mobeeli'); Organization + WebSite JSON-LD in the root layout (site name 'Mobeeli', logo, description, extendable sameAs) so Google shows the brand name above the URL; favicon sizes 48x48 + 192x192 per Google guidelines.
acceptance_criteria: Landing title renders 'Mobeeli | Every part, verified to fit.' (EN) / 'Mobeeli | Setiap suku cadang, dipastikan cocok.' (ID); join title 'Join Waitlist | Mobeeli' — in <title>, OG, and Twitter meta
Root layout emits two server-rendered application/ld+json scripts: Organization (name Mobeeli, url, absolute logo URL, description) and WebSite (name Mobeeli, url); both parse as valid JSON
Favicon served at 48x48 and 192x192 generated from mobeeli-mark.png; apple-icon unchanged
All existing tests updated for the new titles; new tests assert both JSON-LD types are present and valid; suite green
